_note: 資安合規週報的 Watchlist 現況檔。Routine 每期先讀本檔取得基線，查證後回寫 baseline 與 history；里程碑達成時把 milestone.reached 設為 true 並填 date／reportedIn。標的定義（追蹤問題、查證點、查詢角度）以 prompts/weekly-routine.md 為權威，本檔只存現況。scripts/validate_report.py 會用 keywords 檢查每個標的在該期是否有【重點追蹤】項目。

keyDates.what: CRA Article 14 通報義務生效；SRP 規劃同步啟用

milestone.definition: SRP 正式上線且公開網址公布

status.zh: 仍未上線，網址與 CSIRT 名單未公布，現階段不提供 API；規劃與 9/11 通報義務同步啟用；上線首日只開放 Article 14／24 法定通報。ENISA 建議 9/11 前完成帳號開通與角色指派，至少兩名具存取權人員並備妥非上班時間程序。
status.en: Not live; URL and CSIRT coordinator list unpublished; no API at this stage. Planned to launch with the September 11 reporting obligations; day one accepts only Article 14/24 mandatory reports. ENISA advises provisioning accounts and roles beforehand with at least two named users and an out-of-hours process.

history.summary: 未上線；新增首日僅開放 Art.14/24 與兩名存取人員建議。

status.zh: OJ 仍無任何 CRA 調和標準；ETSI 17 項產品標準（EN 304 617–627、631–636）公眾意見徵詢跑到 2026-09 中～11 月中。
status.en: No CRA harmonised standard in the OJ yet; public enquiry on ETSI's 17 product standards (EN 304 617-627, 631-636) runs from mid-September to mid-November 2026.

status.zh: OJ 尚無任何 AI Act 調和標準；EN 18286（Article 17 QMS）已核准發布但待刊登；ISO 42001 非調和標準。
status.en: No AI Act harmonised standard in the OJ; EN 18286 (Article 17 QMS) approved and published but not yet cited; ISO 42001 is not a harmonised standard.

status.zh: CJEU 無公開進展；荷蘭 8/15 生效且登記已強制（觀察是否撤案）；愛爾蘭稱 2026 年底前完成、西班牙未刊 BOE、法國無明確時程。
status.en: No public CJEU progress; the Netherlands' law took effect August 15 with mandatory registration (watch for withdrawal); Ireland says by end-2026, Spain not yet in the BOE, France no clear timeline.
